info.name: Geofence Alerts API
info.description: Every call of the contract (contract/openapi.yaml) plus the added endpoints. Run folder 1 first: it saves the tokens. Users are those of the dev profile (password dev-password). Change baseUrl for another port or for the packaged system.

item.name: Deliver a batch: one good line, one bad line

request.description: Newline-delimited JSON, one report per line. Send it twice: the second time the good line is a duplicate.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test("counts add up", function () { pm.expect(b.received).to.eql(b.accepted + b.duplicates + b.rejected); });

item.name: Deliver with the wrong content type (415)
Assets in a box (saves an asset id)

exec: const items = pm.response.json().items; if (items.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("assetId", items[0].assetId); }

item.name: Assets in a box across the 180 degree line
One asset that does not exist (404)
Track of an asset that does not exist (404)
Alerts, first page (saves an alert id and the cursor)

exec: const r = pm.response.json(); if (r.items.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("alertId", r.items[0].alertId); } pm.collectionVariables.set("cursor", r.nextCursor || "");

item.name: One alert that does not exist (404)
Audit of an alert that does not exist (404)
6 Alert workflow (run in order; it changes the alert)
Release as op02: not the owner (403)
Claim an alert that does not exist (404)
Supervisor demo, step 1: pick another OPEN alert
Supervisor demo, step 2: claim it as op01
Supervisor demo, step 3: sup01 releases op01's alert (a supervisor may)
7 Added endpoints (not in the fixed contract)

exec: const z = pm.response.json().items; if (z.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("zoneId", z[0].zoneId); }

item.name: Assets inside each zone: the counts

request.description: Stays open and sends an event when an alert changes. In Postman, open it and keep it running, then deliver a batch or claim an alert from another request.
